en.title: Gravel bikes around ¥5,000: Twitter Gravel V3 vs PARDUS Super Sport Gen2
en.description: Compare three exact China-market builds using dated price records, drivetrain differences and tire-clearance evidence—not a universal best-bike ranking.
en.intro: A budget of about ¥5,000 produces an interesting comparison in this catalog: a mechanical Twitter Gravel V3, its WheelTop electronic sibling, and the PARDUS Super Sport Gen2 eGR. They are not interchangeable builds, and their prices do not come from equivalent kinds of evidence.

sections.heading: Start with the exact builds, not the brand name
paragraphs: The table below reads directly from the existing catalog. It keeps the mechanical and electronic Twitter configurations separate and labels the PARDUS price as a public market report. These are dated observations, not verified offers available today. Open each model to see its complete price history and the original source context.

The mechanical Twitter record is an anonymized mainland marketplace observation. The WheelTop record is a Taobao search-card coupon observation. The PARDUS record comes from a public exact-model video report. A few yuan between the last two figures cannot establish which bike is actually cheaper at checkout.

sections.heading: The useful difference is 2× versus 1×, not just mechanical versus electronic
paragraphs: The recorded Twitter RS uses a mechanical Sensah 2×12 drivetrain. The WheelTop build uses electronic 2×12, while the PARDUS eGR is electronic 1×12. That changes the comparison you should make: ask for the actual chainring and cassette, then consider the lowest climbing gear and the spacing between gears for your route.

Electronic shifting does not answer the maintenance question by itself. Before ordering, establish who supplies a replacement derailleur, battery or charger, and whether a local shop can diagnose that exact system. The [electronic-shifting reference](/electronic-shifting/) helps separate kit prices, configurations and recorded evidence.

sections.heading: Read clearance and weight with their measurement basis
paragraphs: The Twitter platform record distinguishes a stock tire from its separately documented maximum clearance. The PARDUS record has its own maximum. Do not transfer a figure from one sibling build or generation to another without opening the source. A maximum nominal tire label is also not permission to ignore the actual mounted width or the space needed for your riding conditions.

A listed complete-bike weight applies to a particular build and may depend on size and what was included on the scale. It is not a controlled comparison between these bikes. Keep wheels, pedals and accessories consistent before treating a weight difference as a buying advantage.

sections.heading: What should decide the purchase?
paragraphs: First eliminate any bike that cannot provide the fit, tire setup or gearing you need. Then request a written configuration and final price for your size: frame generation, shifters, derailleurs, brakes, wheel material, tires, shipping and assembly. A product card that offers several component packages is not enough.

Ask the seller to explain the invoice, domestic warranty, return conditions and the route for replacement parts. Save the exact option name with the quote. For these records, a confirmed configuration and a credible after-sales route are more useful than choosing the smallest historical headline price.

sections.heading: What this comparison does not prove
paragraphs: This is a source-led comparison, not a hands-on ride test, stiffness test or assessment of long-term defect rates. Missing measurements are uncertainty, not evidence of a bad bicycle. Start the [three-bike comparison](/?compare=twitter-v3-rs-sensah%2Ctwitter-v3-wheeltop-eds%2Cpardus-super-sport-gen2-egr#compare), then use the model sources to prepare your seller questions.

Overseas readers should not treat these yuan figures as export offers. Shipping eligibility, the supplied build and support can differ. See [how to use domestic prices from abroad](/blog/chinese-bike-prices-for-international-buyers/) before turning the comparison into a budget.

zh-Hans.title: 5,000 元左右 Gravel 怎么选：骓特 Gravel V3 与瑞豹 Super Sport 二代
zh-Hans.description: 分清三个具体配置、有日期的价格依据、变速系统和轮胎空间；不把历史低价当作当前到手价。
zh-Hans.intro: 约 5,000 元预算，在本目录中可以比较骓特 Gravel V3 机械版、WheelTop 电子版，以及瑞豹 Super Sport 二代 eGR。这不是三个可以互换的配置，而且它们的价格证据类型并不相同。

sections.heading: 先看具体配置，不要只看品牌
paragraphs: 下表直接读取现有目录。机械版和电子版骓特分别列出，瑞豹的价格则明确标为公开视频市场报告。这里都是带观察日期的记录，并不是今天已核实的可购买报价。点进车型页，可以查看完整价格记录及原始来源。
机械版骓特来自匿名化的国内市场观察；WheelTop 版来自淘宝搜索卡片的优惠券价格；瑞豹来自具体车型的公开视频报告。后两者历史数字相差几元，不能证明今天谁的最终到手价更低。

sections.heading: 关键不仅是机械或电子，还有单盘或双盘
paragraphs: 目录中的骓特 RS 是顺泰／Sensah 机械 2×12，WheelTop 版是电子 2×12，瑞豹 eGR 则是电子 1×12。先询问具体牙盘与飞轮规格，再结合常走路线比较最低爬坡档和档位间距，比只看“电子变速”四个字更有用。
电子变速本身不能回答维修问题。下单前，问清后拨、电池和充电器的补件渠道，以及本地车店能否诊断该型号。可用[电子变速资料页](/electronic-shifting/)区分不同套件、价格口径与证据。

sections.heading: 轮胎空间和重量都要看口径
paragraphs: 骓特平台记录区分了原装轮胎和另有证据的最大轮胎空间；瑞豹也有自己的最大值。没有核对来源前，不要把同名车其他配置或其他代际的数据移过来。标称最大胎宽也不能取代对实际装车宽度及使用环境所需余量的确认。
整车重量对应特定配置，还可能受尺码、脚踏和附件是否计入影响。这些数字不是统一条件下的横向实测。只有把轮组、脚踏和附件等口径统一后，重量差才适合作为选择依据。

sections.heading: 最终应由哪些条件决定？
paragraphs: 先排除尺码、轮胎方案或齿比不符合需求的车。然后请卖家针对你的尺码给出书面配置和最终价格：车架代际、手变、前后拨、刹车、轮组材料、轮胎、运费及装配。一个同时展示多个配置的商品卡片还不够。
还需问清发票、国内保修、退换条件和补件路径，并把准确的选项名称与报价一起保存。对这些记录而言，确认配置与售后渠道，比在历史价格中挑最小数字更重要。

sections.heading: 这篇对比不能证明什么
paragraphs: 本文是基于来源的资料对比，不是实际骑行、刚性测试或长期故障率调查。缺失数据代表不确定，不代表车差。打开[三车对比](/?compare=twitter-v3-rs-sensah%2Ctwitter-v3-wheeltop-eds%2Cpardus-super-sport-gen2-egr#compare)，再依据车型来源准备向卖家提问。
海外读者不要把这里的人民币数字当作出口报价。能否发货、实际配置及售后可能不同。估算预算前，请阅读[海外买家如何使用国内价格](/blog/chinese-bike-prices-for-international-buyers/)。
